history.summary: A 1,206 sqft freehold 3BR at The Hacienda (D15 Siglap, 1985) at $2.5M / $2,073 PSF — but the project's URA median is just $1,796 PSF, so the listing is ~15% above the project's transacted norm. A 41-year-old development priced rich, hence the rock-bottom score_1000 of 124.
history.rating_rationale: The $2,073 PSF listing sits ~15% above the project's own $1,796 URA median (15 txns), which is exactly why score_1000 craters to 124. The development is from 1985 (41 years old) — old enough to raise maintenance and financing concerns — and at $2.5M the buyer pool is thin. Even though Siglap TEL MRT (760m) and freehold D15 are attractive, paying a ~15% premium to the project's transactions on an aging block is a poor entry for a 5-7yr hold. En-bloc optionality is the only real upside but is speculative.
